About us

A local team that treats you like family

Cornerstone Life & Annuity was founded on a simple belief: financial protection should be clear, honest, and built around your life — not a sales quota. Our licensed advisors take the time to understand your goals, walk you through every option, and stay with you long after the policy is signed.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

How much does a consultation cost?+
Nothing. Your initial consultation and quote are completely free, with zero obligation to buy.
Do you work with multiple insurance carriers?+
Yes. We're independent, so we compare top-rated carriers to find the best fit and price for your situation.
How long does it take to get covered?+
Some plans offer same-day approval. Most applications are completed within a week, and we handle the paperwork for you.
What if I already have a policy?+
We offer a free policy review to check for coverage gaps or potential savings — no pressure to switch.
